# Collection list (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`content-editing`](../../flows/content-editing/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

`/content/:slug`: the draft list of a collection (sort, paging, bulk publish, unpublish, delete, JSON import). A single type is sent on to its one document. Titles use the content type's `displayName`.

## Techniques

TanStack Query for the type and the page; bulk runs report per-item results in a banner; the title is a skeleton while the type loads.

## Technologies

React 19, TanStack Query, react-router, `@abyss/form-commons`.

## Entry points

`CollectionListPage` (route `/content/:slug`), `SingleTypeRedirect`.

## Where to change what

A new bulk action: `useBulkRun.ts` and `Bulk.rules.ts`, with its copy in `configs/copy/Content.copy.ts`. Titles and captions take the display name, never the slug.
